description: An art and craft supply shop near San Antonio that sells a 2 kg block of kiln-firing ceramic clay for hand-building, wheel and sculpture, plus a clay-cutting wire, alongside paints, brushes and polymer clay. Useful for small quantities, not for bulk clay or glaze materials.
descriptionOriginal: Arcilla de textura suave y maleable, ideal para modelado manual, torno, escultura y proyectos cerámicos.
details: The 2 kg clay block was listed at COP 13.500 and the cutting wire at COP 6.000 in October 2026. The clay type and firing range are not stated, so ask before glazing or high firing. No glazes were found. Contact: +57 311 379 5165 (WhatsApp) or Contacto@jberlyart.com. Shipping terms were not shown.

name: Min&Ser Cerámica (Minerales y Servicios)
address: Carrera 48B # 99 sur 59, Bodega 7A, Bodegas San Bartolomé, La Estrella, Antioquia
description: A Medellín-area raw-materials company with a line for studio and hobby ceramics: powdered glazes and frits, brush-on glazes, clay bodies in rolls, ceramic pigments, bisque tableware, refractory kiln shelves and powdered minerals including national and imported feldspar, kaolin, silica (mesh 325), talc, dolomite, wollastonite, nepheline syenite, zircon opacifier and potter's plaster.
descriptionOriginal: Su aliado para la cerámica artesanal y de hobby.
details: Listed glazes and frits include transparents for 1050-1120°C and 1200-1220°C, a zircon white at 1100°C, a matte at 1130-1150°C, and frits P-830 (950°C) and 9573 (1170°C). No prices online: orders are by quote form, WhatsApp or phone (+57 604 444 2070, +57 316 741 1095, info@ceramicas.minser.co), and powdered minerals are made to order. The site does not say whether it ships to Cali, so ask; La Estrella is roughly 420 km from Cali by road. Confirmed active on its Instagram (@minserceramica), latest post seen May 2026; check before ordering.

name: Hornos Santorino
description: A Bogotá maker of electric kilns for ceramics that also restores and repairs kilns, listed in Entre Grietas' directory of Colombian ceramic suppliers.
descriptionOriginal: Fabricación y restauración de hornos eléctricos para cerámica.
details: No website, prices, sizes or temperature ratings were found, and there is no street address (shown at the city centre). Delivery or installation in Cali is not stated, so ask. Confirmed active on its Instagram (@hornossantorino), latest post seen June 2026, so check before ordering; contact is by the technician's number on that profile.

name: Taller de Cerámica Alma de la Tierra
nameEnglish: Alma de la Tierra ceramics workshop
description: Karla Posada's ceramics studio in the hills of west Cali, making one-off pieces and teaching hand-building and wheel classes, ongoing workshops and weekend 'parche cerámigos' sessions where you choose wheel or hand-building. She also teaches guest workshops elsewhere in the city.
descriptionOriginal: Piezas únicas. Clases modelado manual y torno. Experiencias con arcilla.
details: Bookings are by WhatsApp (+57 319 288 4625); the programme of permanent workshops and of the 'parche cerámigos' sessions is in PDFs linked from linktr.ee/almadelatierra, and their prices could not be read. On 18 October 2026 she led a 'Taza + platico' (cup and saucer) workshop, 3-6 pm, at Pulpo Ink Casa Taller in San Fernando (listed by ViveCali). Confirmed active on its Instagram (@ceramica_almadelatierra), October 2026.

name: Serena Morena
description: Paula Borja's handmade ceramics brand and studio, which runs beginner ceramics classes and a children's workshop and makes one-off pieces for the home.
descriptionOriginal: Cada pieza es única, hecha a mano de manera artesanal.
details: The address comes from a business directory (Cybo) and the phone/WhatsApp is +57 300 803 9044. Its Instagram (@serenamorena.co) now gives its base as 'Miami, Fl - Cali, Col.' and announced changes for 2026, so ask whether classes are running in Cali before going. Confirmed active on Instagram, September 2026. No prices could be read.

name: Espirare Terra Taller
description: An arts-and-crafts workshop in west Cali whose programme includes one-off hand-building (modelado manual) ceramics sessions, along with other craft workshops and private group experiences.
descriptionOriginal: Taller de Cerámica: modelado manual.
details: Cali's cultural listings site Circulátelo listed a hand-building session on Saturday 8 August 2026, 3-6 pm, at COP 125.000 per person. Contact espirareterra@gmail.com or WhatsApp via its site. It is a general crafts space rather than a dedicated pottery studio; no wheel or firing service is mentioned. Confirmed active on its Instagram (@espirareterra.taller), October 2026.

name: Ibarra Cerámica – A Mano y Corazón
nameEnglish: Ibarra Ceramics, by hand and heart
address: Shop and studio: Calle 3 Oeste # 1-38, Local 2, El Peñón, Cali (workshop also listed at Carrera 3 # 11-55, San Pedro)
description: Ana María Ibarra's ceramics studio and shop, making handmade figurative pieces in clay fired at high temperature and finished with glazes, oxides and engobes, including Cali characters such as the chontaduro seller.
descriptionOriginal: Las piezas están elaboradas en arcilla de calidad preparada para cocción a altas temperaturas.
details: Open Monday to Friday, 8 am-5:30 pm. Contact +57 311 316 5224, ibarraamanoycorazon@gmail.com. Pieces ship within Colombia (quoted by city). The website does not mention public classes; Entre Grietas lists the studio as an 'espacio abierto', so ask whether it takes visitors or students. Site updated 2025-2026.

name: Pulpo Ink Casa Taller
description: A crafts house founded in 2009 by Judith Barrera that teaches hand screen printing, embroidery and bookbinding, and hosts guest workshops, including ceramics sessions led by Karla Posada of Alma de la Tierra.
descriptionOriginal: Taller de serigrafía personalizado, club de bordado y taller de encuadernación artesanal.
details: Regular programme: screen printing on a permanent schedule, an embroidery club on Thursdays 5-8 pm, and bookbinding plus screen printing on Saturdays at 10 am. A ceramics 'Taza + platico' workshop ran on 18 October 2026, and it hosts a creativity, arts and crafts fair (Feria AMARILLA) on 1 November 2026 (free entry). No prices online. Contact +57 310 836 9683, pulpoinkcasataller@gmail.com.

name: Martha Lia Vallejo – Taller de Arte
address: Condominio Campestre Rincón de las Mercedes, Jamundí
description: An art workshop on the edge of Jamundí, just south of Cali, with ongoing classes in hand-built ceramics, cuerda seca tile decoration, kurinuki and rustic ceramics, alongside glass mosaic, Tiffany stained glass and fused glass.
descriptionOriginal: Clases, talleres permanentes de cerámica, mosaico en vidrio y baldosa, vitral Tiffany, vitrofusión.
details: Classes are arranged by WhatsApp (+57 315 562 0809); the studio also teaches in Cali. Entre Grietas lists it as a private ceramics space in Jamundí. No prices or timetable could be read. Confirmed active on its Instagram (@marthaliavallejo.arte), October 2026.
